narration.full_text: Namaste, students! In this section, we'll embark on an exciting journey to understand the fascinating world of control and coordination in living organisms. We'll explore how animals and plants manage their internal and external environments. By the end of this session, you will be able to clearly articulate the complex mechanisms that allow life to thrive and adapt. Let's delve into the core concepts together.

items: Explore the nervous system in animals, including neurons and nerve impulses.
Differentiate between reflex actions and voluntary actions.
Discover the structure and functions of the human brain.
Learn about coordination mechanisms in plants, including plant hormones.
Understand the role of hormones and the endocrine system in animals.
